_about: HW9 Part 4 ground truth for s1066 municipal transit incidents. Used by the Evaluator Agent (and by the Answering Agent only when a lesson tells it to consult the reference). *_patterns are the evaluator's matching rules.

incidents.title: Route 22 bus mechanical breakdown
incidents.rider_guidance: Transfer to Route 23 at 1st & San Fernando; a replacement bus is on the way.

incidents.title: Blue Line signal failure
incidents.rider_guidance: Trains are single-tracking between Tasman and Baypointe; allow extra time.

incidents.title: Green Line power outage
incidents.rider_guidance: Service has been restored; residual delays are clearing.

incidents.title: Orange Line weekend track work
incidents.rider_guidance: A bus bridge runs every 15 minutes between Mountain View and Whisman.

incidents.title: Rapid 500 collision
incidents.rider_guidance: Buses detour via San Carlos St; stops between 4th and 10th St are temporarily closed.

incidents.title: Route 60 flat tire
incidents.rider_guidance: The bus was replaced and service is back on schedule.

incidents.title: Route 66 traffic signal outage
incidents.cause: traffic signal outage at the intersection
incidents.rider_guidance: Buses detour via Alum Rock Ave; use the temporary stop at Alum Rock & King.

incidents.title: Green Line trespasser on tracks
incidents.rider_guidance: Trains are holding at Diridon and Tamien; use Route 64 as an alternative.

incidents.title: Route 23 bus fire
incidents.rider_guidance: The bus was evacuated; riders should board the shuttle at Stevens Creek & Monroe and stay clear of the area.

incidents.title: Orange Line door malfunction
incidents.rider_guidance: The train was taken out of service; trains are running normally.

incidents.title: Route 72 parade detour
incidents.rider_guidance: Buses detour via 3rd St during the parade; stops on 1st St are closed.

policies.fact: Riders can request a refund for a trip cancelled by an incident within 30 days, online or at a customer service center.
If service on a rider's line is suspended for more than 3 consecutive days, monthly passes are extended by the number of days suspended.
Severity is High for delays of 30 minutes or more or any injury, Medium for 10-29 minute delays, and Low for delays under 10 minutes.
Up to 4 bicycles are allowed per light rail car; buses carry 2 bikes on the front rack.
Text ALERTS to 41411 to subscribe to service disruption alerts.
Lost and found is at the River Oaks Customer Service Center, open weekdays 8 am to 5 pm.
Do not touch the item; move away and tell the operator or call Transit Police at 408-555-0199.
During an elevator outage, call 408-555-0142 to request the free accessible shuttle from the nearest station with a working elevator.
